	if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
		return;

	$screen = function_exists( 'get_current_screen' ) ? get_current_screen() : null;

	if ( ! file_exists( $asset_file ) ) {
		return;
	}

	$asset = include $asset_file;

	wp_enqueue_script(
		'editorial-checklist-editor',
		EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_URL . 'build/index.js',
		$asset['dependencies'],
		$asset['version'],
		array( 'in_footer' => true )
	);

	wp_set_script_translations(
		'editorial-checklist-editor',
		'editorial-checklist',
		EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_DIR . 'languages'
	);

		wp_enqueue_style(
			'editorial-checklist-editor',
			EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_URL . 'build/index.css',
			array( 'wp-components' ),
			$asset['version']
		);
	}

 * Preloads the checklist REST responses so the sidebar renders without a request round trip.
 *
 * @param array                   $paths   Preload paths.
 * @param WP_Block_Editor_Context $context Block editor context.
 * @return array
 */
function editorial_checklist_preload_paths( $paths, $context ) {
	if ( empty( $context->post ) || ! ( $context->post instanceof WP_Post ) ) {
		return $paths;
	}

	$post = $context->post;
	if ( ! editorial_checklist_is_supported_post_type( $post->post_type ) || ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) {
		return $paths;

	$paths[] = add_query_arg(

		$post->post_type,
		'/' . EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_REST_NAMESPACE . '/items'
	);
	$paths[] = '/' . EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_REST_NAMESPACE . '/posts/' . (int) $post->ID;

	return $paths;
}

/**

 *
 * @return string[]

function editorial_checklist_get_post_types() {

	 *
	 * @param string[] $post_types Post type slugs. Default `post` and `page`.

/**
 * Whether the checklist is active on a post type.
 *
 * @param string $post_type Post type slug.
 * @return bool
 */
function editorial_checklist_is_supported_post_type( $post_type ) {
	return is_string( $post_type ) && in_array( $post_type, editorial_checklist_get_post_types(), true );
}

/**
 * Returns the normalized checklist items.
 *

 *
 *     add_filter( 'editorial_checklist_items', function ( $items, $post_type ) {
 *         $items['seo-title'] = array( 'label' => 'SEO title set', 'required' => true );
 *         $items['excerpt']['required'] = true;
 *         unset( $items['taxonomy'] );
 *         return $items;
 *     }, 10, 2 );
 *
 * @param string $post_type Optional. Post type the items are for.
 * @return array<int, array{id: string, label: string, required: bool, description: string}>
 */
function editorial_checklist_get_items( $post_type = '' ) {
	/**
	 * Filters the checklist items.
	 *
	 * @param array  $items     Items keyed by ID. Each item has `label` (string), `required` (bool)
	 *                          and optional `description` (string). An explicit `id` overrides the key.

			continue;
		}

		$label = sanitize_text_field( (string) $item['label'] );
		if ( isset( $item['id'] ) ) {
			$id = sanitize_key( (string) $item['id'] );
		} elseif ( is_string( $key ) ) {
			$id = sanitize_key( $key );
		} else {
			$id = sanitize_key( sanitize_title( $label ) );
		}

		if ( '' === $id || '' === $label || isset( $items[ $id ] ) ) {
			continue;
		}

		$items[ $id ] = array(
			'id'          => $id,
			'label'       => $label,
			'required'    => ! empty( $item['required'] ),
			'description' => isset( $item['description'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( (string) $item['description'] ) : '',

	return array_values( $items );

/**

 * @return string[]
 */
function editorial_checklist_sanitize_checked( $value ) {
	if ( ! is_array( $value ) ) {
		return array();
	}

	$ids = array_map(
		static function ( $id ) {
			return is_scalar( $id ) ? sanitize_key( (string) $id ) : '';
		},
		$value
	);

	return array_values( array_unique( array_filter( $ids ) ) );

/**

 * @return void
 */
function editorial_checklist_register_meta() {
	foreach ( editorial_checklist_get_post_types() as $post_type ) {
		register_post_meta(
			$post_type,
			EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_META_KEY,
			array(
				'type'              => 'array',
				'single'            => true,
				'default'           => array(),
				'show_in_rest'      => false,
				'sanitize_callback' => 'editorial_checklist_sanitize_checked',
				'auth_callback'     => static function ( $allowed, $meta_key, $post_id ) {
					return current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post_id );
				},
			)
		);
	}
}

/**

 *
 * @param int $post_id Post ID.
 * @return string[]
 */
function editorial_checklist_get_checked( $post_id ) {
	$stored = editorial_checklist_sanitize_checked( get_post_meta( $post_id, EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_META_KEY, true ) );
	$known  = wp_list_pluck( editorial_checklist_get_items( (string) get_post_type( $post_id ) ), 'id' );

	return array_values( array_intersect( $stored, $known ) );
}

/**
 * Saves the checked item IDs for a post. Unknown IDs are discarded.
 *
 * @param int   $post_id Post ID.
 * @param array $checked Checked item IDs.
 * @return string[] The stored IDs.
 */
function editorial_checklist_set_checked( $post_id, $checked ) {
	$known   = wp_list_pluck( editorial_checklist_get_items( (string) get_post_type( $post_id ) ), 'id' );
	$checked = array_values( array_intersect( editorial_checklist_sanitize_checked( $checked ), $known ) );

	update_post_meta( $post_id, EDITORIAL_CHECKLIST_META_KEY, $checked );

	/**
	 * Fires after the checklist state of a post is saved.
	 *
	 * @param int      $post_id Post ID.
	 * @param string[] $checked Checked item IDs.
	 */

	return $checked;
}

/**
 * Returns the required items that are not checked for a post.
 *
 * @param int    $post_id   Post ID. 0 for a post that does not exist yet.
 * @param string $post_type Optional. Post type, used when the post does not exist yet.
 * @return array[] Unchecked required items.
 */
function editorial_checklist_get_missing_required( $post_id, $post_type = '' ) {
	if ( '' === $post_type ) {
		$post_type = (string) get_post_type( $post_id );
	}

	$checked = $post_id ? editorial_checklist_get_checked( $post_id ) : array();

	return array_values(
		array_filter(
			editorial_checklist_get_items( $post_type ),
			static function ( $item ) use ( $checked ) {
				return $item['required'] && ! in_array( $item['id'], $checked, true );
			}
		)
	);
}

/**
 * Hooks server-side publish enforcement into the REST API for each supported post type.
 *
 * @return void
 */
function editorial_checklist_register_publish_enforcement() {
	foreach ( editorial_checklist_get_post_types() as $post_type ) {
		add_filter( "rest_pre_insert_{$post_type}", 'editorial_checklist_enforce_on_publish', 10, 2 );
	}
}

/**
 * Rejects REST requests that would publish a post with unchecked required items.
 *
 * This backs up the editor-side lock so the rule can't be bypassed by calling the API directly.
 *
 * @param stdClass|WP_Error $prepared_post Post prepared for the database.
 * @param WP_REST_Request   $request       Request object.
 * @return stdClass|WP_Error
 */
function editorial_checklist_enforce_on_publish( $prepared_post, $request ) {
	if ( is_wp_error( $prepared_post ) ) {
		return $prepared_post;
	}

	$post_id        = isset( $prepared_post->ID ) ? (int) $prepared_post->ID : 0;
	$current_status = $post_id ? get_post_status( $post_id ) : false;
	$new_status     = isset( $prepared_post->post_status ) ? $prepared_post->post_status : $current_status;
	$publishing     = array( 'publish', 'future' );

	// Only act on the transition into a published state.
	if ( ! in_array( $new_status, $publishing, true ) || in_array( $current_status, $publishing, true ) ) {
		return $prepared_post;
	}

	$post_type = isset( $prepared_post->post_type ) ? $prepared_post->post_type : (string) get_post_type( $post_id );
	$missing   = editorial_checklist_get_missing_required( $post_id, $post_type );

	/**
	 * Filters whether publishing is blocked on the server while required items are unchecked.
	 *
	 * @param bool            $enforce Whether to block. Default true when items are missing.
	 * @param int             $post_id Post ID, 0 for new posts.
	 * @param array[]         $missing Unchecked required items.
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request object.
	 */
	if ( empty( $missing ) || ! apply_filters( 'editorial_checklist_enforce_on_publish', true, $post_id, $missing, $request ) ) {
		return $prepared_post;
	}

	return new WP_Error(
		'editorial_checklist_incomplete',
		sprintf(
			/* translators: %s: comma-separated list of checklist item labels. */
			__( 'This post cannot be published until the required editorial checklist items are complete: %s', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			implode( ', ', wp_list_pluck( $missing, 'label' ) )
		),
		array(
			'status'  => 400,
			'missing' => wp_list_pluck( $missing, 'id' ),
		)
	);
}

	 * Registers the routes.

				),
				array(
					'methods'             => WP_REST_Server::EDITABLE,
					'callback'            => array( $this, 'update_post_state' ),
					'permission_callback' => array( $this, 'post_state_permissions_check' ),
					'args'                => array(

							'type'              => 'array',
							'items'             => array( 'type' => 'string' ),
							'required'          => true,
							'sanitize_callback' => 'editorial_checklist_sanitize_checked',
						),
					),
				),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Only users who can edit posts may load the checklist items.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function get_items_permissions_check( $request ) {
		if ( current_user_can( 'edit_posts' ) ) {
			return true;
		}

		return new WP_Error(
			'rest_forbidden',
			__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to view the editorial checklist.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Validates the post_type argument.
	 *
	 * @param mixed $value Value.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function validate_post_type( $value ) {
		if ( is_string( $value ) && editorial_checklist_is_supported_post_type( sanitize_key( $value ) ) ) {
			return true;
		}

		return new WP_Error(
			'rest_invalid_param',
			__( 'The editorial checklist is not enabled for this post type.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
			array( 'status' => 400 )
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the checklist items.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function get_items( $request ) {
		$items = array_map(
			function ( $item ) use ( $request ) {
				return $this->prepare_response_for_collection( $this->prepare_item_for_response( $item, $request ) );
			},
			editorial_checklist_get_items( $request['post_type'] )
		);

		return rest_ensure_response( $items );
	}

	 * Prepares a single item for the response.
	 *
	 * @param array           $item    Item.
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function prepare_item_for_response( $item, $request ) {
		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'id'          => (string) $item['id'],
				'label'       => (string) $item['label'],
				'required'    => (bool) $item['required'],
				'description' => (string) $item['description'],
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * The user must be able to edit the specific post.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return true|WP_Error
	 */
	public function post_state_permissions_check( $request ) {
		$post = get_post( (int) $request['id'] );

		if ( ! $post || ! editorial_checklist_is_supported_post_type( $post->post_type ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_post_invalid_id',
				__( 'Invalid post ID.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
				array( 'status' => 404 )
			);
		}

		if ( ! current_user_can( 'edit_post', $post->ID ) ) {
			return new WP_Error(
				'rest_forbidden',
				__( 'Sorry, you are not allowed to edit the checklist for this post.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
				array( 'status' => rest_authorization_required_code() )
			);
		}

		return true;
	}

	/**
	 * Returns the checklist state for a post.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function get_post_state( $request ) {
		return $this->prepare_post_state( (int) $request['id'] );
	}

	/**
	 * Saves the checklist state for a post.
	 *
	 * @param WP_REST_Request $request Request.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	public function update_post_state( $request ) {
		$post_id = (int) $request['id'];
		editorial_checklist_set_checked( $post_id, (array) $request['checked'] );

		return $this->prepare_post_state( $post_id );
	}

	/**
	 * Builds the post state response.
	 *
	 * @param int $post_id Post ID.
	 * @return WP_REST_Response
	 */
	protected function prepare_post_state( $post_id ) {
		return rest_ensure_response(
			array(
				'post_id'          => $post_id,
				'checked'          => editorial_checklist_get_checked( $post_id ),
				'missing_required' => wp_list_pluck( editorial_checklist_get_missing_required( $post_id ), 'id' ),
			)
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Schema for a checklist item.
	 *
	 * @return array
	 */
	public function get_item_schema() {
		if ( $this->schema ) {
			return $this->add_additional_fields_schema( $this->schema );
		}

		$this->schema = array(
			'$schema'    => 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#',
			'title'      => 'editorial-checklist-item',
			'type'       => 'object',
			'properties' => array(
				'id'          => array(
					'description' => __( 'Unique item ID.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
					'type'        => 'string',
					'readonly'    => true,
				),
				'label'       => array(
					'description' => __( 'Item label.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
					'type'        => 'string',
					'readonly'    => true,
				),
				'required'    => array(
					'description' => __( 'Whether the item must be checked before publishing.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
					'type'        => 'boolean',
					'readonly'    => true,
				),
				'description' => array(
					'description' => __( 'Optional help text.', 'editorial-checklist' ),
					'type'        => 'string',
					'readonly'    => true,
				),
			),
		);

		return $this->add_additional_fields_schema( $this->schema );
	}

=== Editorial Checklist ===
Contributors:      editorialchecklist
Tags:              editorial, checklist, publishing, workflow
Requires at least: 6.7
Tested up to:      6.9

Adds a pre-publish editorial checklist to the block editor.

== Description ==

* A sidebar ("Editorial Checklist") shows every item as a checkbox, with a progress bar.
* The pre-publish panel lists unfinished required items, and you can check them off there.
* While any required item is unchecked, saving and publishing are locked and an editor notice explains why.
* Checked items are saved per post (post meta `_editorial_checklist_checked`) as soon as they change.
* The server also refuses REST requests that would publish a post with unchecked required items.

== Build ==

    npm install
    npm run build

== Developers ==

= Add or change items (PHP) =

    add_filter( 'editorial_checklist_items', function ( $items, $post_type ) {
        $items['seo-title'] = array(
            'label'       => __( 'SEO title is set', 'my-plugin' ),
            'required'    => true,
            'description' => __( 'Check the snippet preview.', 'my-plugin' ),
        );
        $items['excerpt']['required'] = true; // Make a built-in item required.
        unset( $items['taxonomy'] );           // Remove a built-in item.
        return $items;
    }, 10, 2 );

Other filters:

* `editorial_checklist_post_types` – post types the checklist runs on (default `post`, `page`).
* `editorial_checklist_enforce_on_publish` – return false to turn off the server-side publish check.
* Action `editorial_checklist_updated( $post_id, $checked )` – fires after a post's checklist state is saved.

= Read progress (JavaScript) =

    const progress = wp.data.select( 'editorial-checklist' ).getProgress();
    // { total, checked, required, requiredChecked, percent, isComplete, isReady }

Other selectors: `getItems()`, `getCheckedItemIds()`, `isItemChecked( id )`,
`getRequiredItems()`, `getUncheckedRequiredItems()`, `isComplete()`, `isReady()`.

Or subscribe to changes:

    wp.hooks.addAction( 'editorialChecklist.progressChanged', 'my-plugin', ( progress ) => {} );

= REST API =

* `GET  /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/items?post_type=post` – needs `edit_posts`.
* `GET  /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>` – needs `edit_post` for that post.
* `POST /wp-json/editorial-checklist/v1/posts/<id>` with `{ "checked": [ "id", ... ] }` – needs `edit_post`.
